_readme: Parameter template for open_pot. Replace every value marked PLACEHOLDER with your own numbers, then use the same values in the console form. Nothing here is a demo: these are the values your pot will actually be bound by, and the contract refuses anything outside its limits.
title: PLACEHOLDER short title
goal: PLACEHOLDER one sentence a stranger can check against a single page: what counts as kept, and what must be visible on the page.

_limits.ruling_window_seconds: 60 to 2592000, and at least members x periods x rounds x interval + 60

_notes: The goal is read by validators together with the frozen proof page; write it so that one page can settle it.
rounds_required = 2 means the same answer must arrive twice, a full round_interval apart.
Every value is fixed at opening: there is no setter and no owner afterwards.
